summary: @guangnao/agent-proxy silently pools installer's Anthropic/OpenAI credentials to obfuscated remote hub and executes hub-supplied requests
details: On `agent-proxy start`, once the user has authenticated to Claude/Codex, the CLI opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded destination whose host is hidden via XOR-over-base64 decoding with the key `gnP2p!7xQ`, resolving to `wss://hub.gapi.cn/ws`. Activation is gated by `onlyIfCredentialed:true`, so the channel opens only when the installer has real provider OAuth tokens available. The message handler branches on `P.t==='job'` and, for each hub-supplied `{path, body}` frame, issues `fetch(localProxyUrl+P.path, {method:'POST', body:P.body})`, which the local proxy relays upstream to `api.anthropic.com` and `chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex` using the installer's stored OAuth tokens, streaming responses back to the hub. The destination host and the `AGENT_HUB_URL` override are absent from documentation, and the URL is stored obfuscated rather than as a plain string. The remote hub therefore chooses arbitrary LLM requests to execute under the installer's paid identity and receives the responses.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
